name: bible-api.com
summary: Free, keyless Bible verses by reference, book and chapter listings, and random verses in public-domain translations.
notes: Keyless. Rate limit: 15 requests per 30 seconds per IP; do not use it to download whole Bibles.
Two styles: a free-text reference (john 3:16, matt 25:31-33,46) or the /data paths that need exact translation and book ids (JHN, GEN).

Translation ids: web (default), kjv, asv, bbe, bsb, darby, dra, webbe, oeb-us, oeb-cw, plus non-English ones such as cherokee, rccv (Romanian), cuv, luther1912, synodal, rv1909, clementine; /data lists them all.

endpoints.name: Get verses by reference
endpoints.summary: The text of one verse, a range or a list, from a typed reference.

translation.description: Translation id, default web (World English Bible). Others include kjv, asv, bbe, darby, dra, bsb, webbe, oeb-us, oeb-cw, cherokee, rccv, cuv, luther1912, synodal, rv1909.

single_chapter_book_matching.description: Set to indifferent so a bare chapter of a one-chapter book (jude 1) returns the whole book rather than its first verse.

endpoints.name: List translations
endpoints.summary: Every available translation id with its language and name.

endpoints.name: List books of a translation
endpoints.summary: The books (with ids like GEN, JHN) in one translation.

endpoints.name: Get a chapter
endpoints.summary: Every verse of one chapter; without the chapter, the book's chapter list.

endpoints.name: Get a random verse
endpoints.summary: One random verse from a translation, optionally limited to books or a testament.

books.description: Comma-separated book ids, or OT or NT.

notes: For a random verse from the whole Bible call /data/{translation}/random, which this entry does not name separately.
